auth.subtitle: Use your {app} account
auth.securityNote: Protected by multi-factor authentication. Never share your password or verification codes.
auth.heroText: The staff portal of NIB Digital Solutions: manage the digital products catalogue, demo requests, customer enquiries and ideas in one secure place.

reasons.idle: You were signed out after a period of inactivity.
reasons.expired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.
reasons.password_reset: Your password was changed. Sign in with the new password.

errors.account_locked: Your account is temporarily locked after too many failed attempts. Try again later or contact support.
errors.account_disabled: Your account is not active. Contact your administrator.
errors.mfa_expired: The verification request has expired. Please sign in again.
errors.mfa_too_many: Too many incorrect codes. Please sign in again.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Please wait a minute and try again.
errors.unavailable: Sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.
errors.password_change_required: Choose a new password to continue.
errors.password_change_expired: The password change request expired. Please sign in again.

mfa.title: Two-step verification
mfa.totpInstructions: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
mfa.smsInstructions: Enter the 6-digit code we sent to your phone.

idle.title: Are you still there?
idle.description: For your security you will be signed out in {seconds} seconds.

auth.privacy: We secure your data in line with our Privacy Policy.
auth.help: Trouble signing in? Contact your IT Help Desk.
auth.forgotHelp: For your security, passwords are reset by your administrator. Contact your IT Help Desk; after a reset you will be asked to sign in with the temporary password.
auth.privacyStatement: We secure your data in line with our <link>Privacy Policy</link>.
auth.socialLabel: NIB International Bank on social media

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.intro: Enter your username or e-mail address and we will e-mail you a link to choose a new password.
forgot.required: Enter your username or e-mail address
forgot.sentBody: If an account exists for {identifier}, a link to choose a new password is on its way to the e-mail address of that account.
forgot.sentHint: The link can be used once and expires soon. If nothing arrives in a few minutes, check your spam folder or contact your IT Help Desk.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.intro: Choose a new password for your account. You will sign in with it afterwards.
reset.invalidBody: The reset link is invalid, was already used or has expired.

passwordChange.title: Choose a new password
passwordChange.expired: Your password has expired. Choose a new one to continue.
passwordChange.reset: Your password was set by an administrator. Choose your own password to continue.
